purposeStatement: A single collapsible section whose header row toggles a body region open/closed; use to progressively disclose one block of content. NOT for tabs (mutually exclusive views), navigation, or a persistent always-visible surface (use Card).

antiPatterns.pattern: A raw <div>/<button> wired with onClick + inline padding/border-radius/box-shadow and a rotating chevron to expand/collapse content
antiPatterns.reason: Re-invents the disclosure pattern as an inline one-off, hardcodes spacing/border/radius literals, and drops the aria-expanded/aria-controls accessibility wiring.

antiPatterns.pattern: Using <Card> with a manually toggled hidden body to fake collapsibility
antiPatterns.reason: Card is a static bounded surface with no disclosure semantics; faking toggle state on it diverges from the canonical expand/collapse component.
